source.title: Symbolic ensemble learning enables discovery of fast accurate physics-based interatomic potentials

relevance: Physically structured symbolic-ensemble methods may be evaluated as a candidate screening workflow for material-specific effective models. The cited study is aluminum-only and is not a Pangola-carbon or UQPU result.
promotion_gates: pin source revision, code/data and supplementary artifacts; record unavailable artifacts
freeze train/validation/held-out partitions and resource budget
compare incumbent EAM, individual symbolic candidates, ensemble and declared ML potential
report energy and force errors separately with property-specific held-out metrics
check units, invariance, stability, cutoff and domain; preserve counterexamples and failed seeds
separate carbon-specific dataset and independent material qualification before any INV-030 substitution claim
lifecycle functional-equivalence and economics before technology promotion
non_claims: no bio-oil, fusion-electricity or financing result
no Data-Center-to-Phone compression or UQPU advantage
